_comment: Custom transforms for Command Mode and the menu bar's Transform menu. Each has an id, a name you can say ('run <name>'), and instructions for the local cleanup model, which is given the selected text and nothing else. Built-in transforms (Polish, Shorten, Expand, Fix Grammar, Make Professional, Make Casual, Bulletize, Summarize, Improve Prompt) are always available. Settings > Commands edits this file.

custom.name: Claude Code prompt
custom.instructions: Turn this selected text into a clear Claude Code implementation prompt: state the goal, the constraints, and what done looks like. Keep every detail from the text and add none.
